reports.notes: 1.PNG only. NOT the usual SELECT REPORT / REPORT CRITERIA layout: the screenshot (1366x586 px) shows one single-purpose statement-run form with no report radio list, no 'REPORT CRITERIA' heading and no grey section-header bars. The name 'Statements' is the title-bar text (there is no filled report radio). The three section titles are descriptive placeholders prefixed '[no header]', NOT on-screen text. Layout: one light-grey rounded container holding two side-by-side bordered tables whose rows are a label cell plus a value cell, with alternating row shading. LEFT TABLE, 7 rows: (1) Statement Date + info icon - date box 11/20/2026 with calendar icon, FINANCE CHARGES button; (2) Responsible Party Range - Start Name AAAAA + SEARCH, End Name ZZZZZ + SEARCH; (3) Account Balance Over - 5.00; (4) checkbox Include Credit Balances - radio Sort by Resp.Party Lastname (filled); (5) checkbox Suppress Aging - radio Sort by Resp.Party ID; (6) checkbox Hide Insurance Shares - empty value cell; (7) checkbox Hide Credit Card Section - empty value cell. RIGHT TABLE, 8 rows: (1) Last Statement Date - blank; (2) Last Close Out Date - 12/31/2019; (3) Print Reports - greyed PAPER STATEMENT SENT button; (4)-(7) four full-width 'Exclude ...' checkbox rows (the first with an inline days dropdown showing 0; the second is the only checked box); (8) Exclude Responsible Party Type - read-only box 'None' + SELECT button. BELOW THE TABLES: red text 'Maximum 100 characters per message' (no message input is rendered), a thin horizontal rule, the red 'Note: ...' line, then a blue-grey footer strip with three right-aligned blue (enabled) buttons, left to right: PRINT STATEMENT REPORT (printer icon), PRINT STATEMENTS (printer icon), UPDATE STATEMENT DATES (document icon) - these are recorded as the actions. There is NO CLEAR CRITERIA, PRINT / PREVIEW or ADD TO MY FAVORITES button, and no print-format, report-format, office/group, provider or date-range selector on this screen. Only PAPER STATEMENT SENT is greyed out. Not truncated: the rounded bottom edge of the container and the footer strip are fully visible, the page below is blank and there is no scrollbar; the only open point is the missing message input(s) implied by the red hint. Verified by whole-image pixel scans: every cluster of text/icon pixels and every box or line on the screen corresponds to an element listed here (the only input boxes drawn are the date box, the two name boxes, the balance box, the days dropdown and the 'None' box). No dropdown is expanded and no popup is open.

observations: Third-reader verified inventory. The original screenshot, both pre-rendered crops and 23 extra crops (prefix c3_ in the zoom folder: 21 crops at 1.15x-12x plus two contrast-equalised halves) were read, and whole-image pixel scans were run (clusters of dark text/icon pixels, light boxes and borders, uniformity of every blank cell and margin, fill colours of every input, button, checkbox and radio). SCREEN TYPE: this category has a single screenshot (1.PNG) and it is NOT the standard report-selector screen - there is no left 'SELECT REPORT' radio list and no right 'REPORT CRITERIA' panel with grey section-header bars. report_list is therefore EMPTY ON PURPOSE (no list exists on screen) and reports_without_screenshot is empty; the whole screen is transcribed as the single entry reports[0], named 'Statements' after the title bar. It is a statement-run form (batch billing statements selected by responsible party) with two print outputs (PRINT STATEMENT REPORT, PRINT STATEMENTS), one maintenance action (UPDATE STATEMENT DATES), a FINANCE CHARGES button and a disabled PAPER STATEMENT SENT button under the row label 'Print Reports'. The pre-rendered crops simply split this form down the middle: 1_list.png = left table + red texts, 1_criteria.png = right table + footer buttons + title-bar identifiers. READERS: A and B agreed on the screen type, the empty report_list, the report name, every visible text, every default, the single disabled control, the three actions and the not-truncated verdict; all of it was re-checked on the pixels and confirmed. They differed only in modelling: (a) A recorded the row labels 'Responsible Party Range' and 'Print Reports' as static_text controls while B kept them in notes - kept as static_text here because they are visible captions that are not the label of any single control (hence 26 controls); (b) the info icon label (A a bracketed description, B 'i') - recorded with an empty label, as in the other categories, since the icon carries no text; (c) row 4 of the right table - the checkbox label is the exact text before the inline dropdown and the dropdown is labelled with the trailing text 'days.' (B had put a '[dropdown]' placeholder inside the checkbox label and left the dropdown unlabelled); (d) the wording of the placeholder section titles - shortened to '[no header] LEFT TABLE', '[no header] RIGHT TABLE', '[no header] BELOW THE TABLES'. TITLE BAR: 'Statements' at left; identifiers 'PGID :2829 / OID :108' at right, followed by an unlabeled white printer icon at the far right edge (not part of the form and not counted as an action). DEFAULTS AS DISPLAYED: Statement Date 11/20/2026 (both readers assumed this was the capture date, but it is one day BEFORE the 2026-11-21 capture date indicated by the file timestamp and by the 11/21/2026 date defaults on the other categories' screenshots taken the same evening - so it is apparently not a plain current-date default and its rule is unknown), Start Name AAAAA, End Name ZZZZZ, Account Balance Over 5.00, sort radio = 'Sort by Resp.Party Lastname', days dropdown = 0, Exclude Responsible Party Type = None, Last Statement Date blank, Last Close Out Date 12/31/2019. Checkboxes: only 'Exclude accounts where patient portion is paid and insurance portion is expected' is checked; the other seven are unchecked (Include Credit Balances, Suppress Aging, Hide Insurance Shares, Hide Credit Card Section, Exclude accounts where statement was sent within last ... days., Exclude patients Sent to Collection., Exclude Responsible Parties where the Patient has an open claim). ENABLED STATES: the only greyed-out control is the PAPER STATEMENT SENT button (grey fill RGB 176,183,190 versus blue RGB 0,108,187 on the seven other buttons); the 'None' box of the picker is a read-only grey box (RGB 225,225,225, grey text) but its SELECT button is enabled; the date, name and balance boxes and the days dropdown have the light editable fill (RGB 241,241,241) with black text. ABSENT: no office/group, provider, date-range, print-format, report-format, group-by or page-break controls exist on this screen; the office context presumably comes from the OID in the title bar (the red note speaks of 'respective Office Statements') - inference. MISSING MESSAGE INPUT: the red hint 'Maximum 100 characters per message' is shown without any message text box; the light-element scan found only six input boxes on the whole screen (date, Start Name, End Name, balance, days dropdown, None) and the area around and below the hint is pixel-uniform, so the statement message field(s) the hint refers to are not rendered in this state - their number and labels cannot be taken from this screenshot and should be confirmed on the live legacy screen. NOT SHOWN: the dialogs behind FINANCE CHARGES, the two SEARCH buttons and the SELECT button, the option list of the days dropdown and the tooltip of the info icon. CAPTURE: 1366x586 px; nothing lies below the container (blank page from y 479) except a uniform 3 px grey line on the last pixel rows (y 583-585, identical across all 1366 px - a frame border, not a scrollbar); no scrollbars, popups or expanded dropdowns. All text was legible after zooming; no uncertain readings remain.
